Components

Card

A flexible surface that groups related content and actions into a single visual unit.

stable
Since 1.2.0 A11y: WCAG 2.2 AA · whole-card link pattern verified Source: packages/react/src/Card/Card.tsx Figma ↗

A Card is a raised surface that bundles related information — a header, body, and optional footer — into one scannable unit. It's the building block for dashboards, settings panels, and content grids.

Example

Production cluster

Healthy

12 nodes · 99.98% uptime over the last 30 days.

View metrics →
html
<article class="halo-card">
  <header class="halo-card__header">
    <h3>Production cluster</h3>
    <span class="badge badge--stable">Healthy</span>
  </header>
  <div class="halo-card__body">
    <p>12 nodes · 99.98% uptime over the last 30 days.</p>
  </div>
  <footer class="halo-card__footer">View metrics →</footer>
</article>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
elevation'flat' | 'raised''raised'Flat draws a border; raised adds a shadow.
interactivebooleanfalseAdds hover/focus affordance for clickable cards.
asElementType'div'Polymorphic root element (e.g. article, a).
padding*'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg''md'Inner spacing of the card body.

Guidelines

Do

Keep one clear primary action per card.

Don't

Nest cards inside cards — flatten the hierarchy instead.

Accessibility

  • A whole-card link uses the "pseudo-content" pattern: a single <a> stretched over the card with ::after, so the entire surface is one accessible target.
  • When interactive, the card is keyboard-focusable and shows the standard --halo-focus-ring.

Note

For a grid of cards, wrap them in a <ul> of <li> items so screen readers announce the count.
